stimulus.text: The Greenfield Municipal Library placed a book-return box outside its main door in March. Before that, readers could return books only during opening hours, from 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. In the six months before the box, the library recorded an average of 420 late returns a month. In the six months after it, the monthly average fell to 270. The librarian noted that the box was emptied each morning and that fines were still charged from the date of actual return, not from the date the box was emptied. A reminder-text service was also started in June, and the librarian said that it may have contributed to the fall. The library has therefore decided to continue both measures and to compare returns again after a full year.
